 Advertising Reports: Ravens to Sign Quarterback Kedon Slovis
 Nov 03, 2026 at 10:00 AM Clifton Brown BaltimoreRavens.com Staff Writer
 Copied! 
 Matt Ludtke/AP Photo QB Kedon Slovis The Ravens are signing 25-year-old quarterback Kedon Slovis off the Green Bay Packers' practice squad, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer has reported.
 A new QB in Baltimore: The Ravens are signing Kedon Slovis to their 53-man roster off the Packers’ practice squad, sources tell @ringer @netflixsports . 
The options for Thursday night against Jacksonville now include Joe Fagnano, Austin Reed and Slovis, who played in two games…
— Tom Pelissero (@TomPelissero) November 3, 2026 He will reportedly add depth to Baltimore's quarterback room following injuries to Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler "Snoop" Huntley (toe) during Sunday's loss to the Buffalo Bills.
 Slovis appeared in two games with the Arizona Cardinals last season and saw limited action, attempting just two passes. He will reunite with Ravens Quarterback Coach Israel Woolfork, who coached Slovis in Arizona last season. Slovis also played at USC when Ravens Wide Receivers Coach Keary Colbert held the same position with the Trojans, his alma mater.
 Slovis was undrafted in 2024 after being an All-Pac-12 quarterback at USC. After three seasons in Los Angeles, Slovis transferred to Pittsburgh and played one season there before finishing his college career at BYU.
 Austin Reed, who saw action at quarterback in all three of the Ravens' preseason games, was signed to the practice squad on Monday afternoon. Reed will likely back up Joe Fagnano, who made his NFL regular-season debut in Buffalo after Jackson and Huntley went down.
 Fagnano suffered an injury on a low hit by Bills defensive lineman Ed Oliver but played through it to finish the game. Fagnano was listed on the injury report (ankle) following Monday's walkthrough.
